literal_source_en: One person extends an envelope while the other person's open hand remains separated from it by a visible gap.

frozen_owner_bindings.A: man/adjacent commuter already described in baseline
frozen_owner_bindings.envelope: small sealed cream envelope, local paper-carrier refinement

gates.requirement: The existing man's right hand visibly holds and extends the same readable envelope. Hand/wrist/forearm trace to his body.
The existing woman's left receiving hand is open and empty; wrist/forearm trace to her body and remain separate from her right bouquet hand.
A clear background gap separates her nearest fingertip/hand boundary from the same envelope's near edge; no touching, joint grip, substituted object or occlusion.
Both actors, the giver hand, open receiver hand, one envelope and the gap coexist with readable owner chains in one saved image.

rule.claim_limit: The pose is no proof of secrecy, hesitation, allegiance, envelope contents or successful communication.
